beats.label: S1 · Arrival at Cousins
beats.text: The Conklins arrive at the Fisher beach house for another summer. Belly, now 16, still loves Conrad, but he's grown distant and moody, and she can't figure out why.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes the two families, Belly's central crush, and the Conrad mystery that drives every subsequent beat.

beats.label: S1 · Debutante and Cam
beats.text: Susannah asks Belly to be a debutante, pulling her into a season alongside Conrad's ex Nicole. Belly meets a boy named Cam at a bonfire and starts dating him.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The debutante season is the season's spine — every escalation with Conrad and Jeremiah routes back to it.

beats.label: S1 · The unopened gift
beats.text: At her birthday, Belly finds out Conrad bought her a sentimental necklace but never gave it. His feelings for her are real, but locked away by something he won't share.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Confirms Conrad reciprocates, and plants the withheld secret that pays off at the ball.

beats.label: S1 · Fourth of July
beats.text: At the Fourth of July, Belly and Conrad nearly kiss before Jeremiah interrupts. Conrad then pulls back for reasons of his own, and Belly breaks up with Cam anyway.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The near-kiss + Conrad's retreat is the pivot that redirects Belly toward Jeremiah.

beats.label: S1 · Jeremiah steps in
beats.text: Rejected by Conrad, Belly grows close to Jeremiah, who confesses he loves her and kisses her. She now stands between the two brothers she has known her whole life.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The triangle that anchors seasons 2 and 3 is fully formed here.

beats.label: S1 · The secret breaks
beats.text: On debutante night Jeremiah discovers Susannah has cancer — the secret Conrad has carried alone all summer. Susannah finally agrees to begin treatment.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Explains Conrad's whole season and detonates the emotional charge that carries into S2.

beats.label: S1 · Beach kiss at dawn
beats.text: With Susannah's diagnosis out, Conrad's guard falls. In the early hours after the ball he and Belly kiss on the beach — with Jeremiah's own confession still between them.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The single event S2 opens off of — Conrad and Belly's beginning, and the wound it leaves in Jeremiah.

cliffhanger.text: Susannah's cancer is finally in the open and she has agreed to treatment. Conrad has just kissed Belly on the beach — but Jeremiah has already told her he loves her.
questions: Can Susannah beat the cancer she's been hiding all summer?
What happens to Belly and Conrad's kiss now that Jeremiah has told her he loves her?
How does Jeremiah react when he learns which brother she chose?

characters.name: Belly Conklin
characters.line: The sixteen-year-old at the center of the summer; loves Conrad since she was ten and has just been told by Jeremiah he loves her too.

characters.name: Conrad Fisher
characters.line: Older Fisher brother; hid his mother's cancer all summer, pushed Belly away because of it, and finally kissed her the morning after the ball.

characters.name: Jeremiah Fisher
characters.line: Younger Fisher brother, Belly's lifelong friend; confessed he loves her mid-summer, then found out on Susannah's phone that she has cancer.

characters.name: Susannah Fisher
characters.line: Laurel's best friend and the boys' mother; hid her cancer through the summer and has just agreed to start treatment.

characters.name: Laurel Park
characters.line: Belly's mother, novelist and Susannah's oldest friend; slept with fellow author Cleveland Castillo this summer.

characters.name: Steven Conklin
characters.line: Belly's older brother; escorted debutante Shayla but also kissed Belly's best friend Taylor early in the summer.

characters.name: Taylor Jewel
characters.line: Belly's best friend from home; kissed Steven when she visited Cousins.

beats.label: S2 · After Susannah
beats.text: Susannah has died. Belly and Conrad became a couple after the ball then broke apart in grief, and now Conrad has vanished from Brown — Jeremiah calls Belly for help.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Resets every relationship from S1's ending in one beat and starts the summer's search.

beats.label: S2 · The house is for sale
beats.text: Belly and Jeremiah drive out to find Conrad and learn the beach house itself is under threat: Aunt Julia has become its legal owner and wants to sell.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces the season's engine — every other beat routes through saving the house.

beats.label: S2 · Fighting for Cousins
beats.text: The teens spend the summer trying to save the house — Conrad through a secret trust plan, Belly and Jeremiah head-on — while Julia empties it and lists it for open house.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Compresses the middle of the season while showing the fault lines between the brothers.

beats.label: S2 · Farewell party truths
beats.text: A farewell party breaks everything open. Jeremiah warns Conrad off Belly, and Belly finally learns that at the funeral, when Conrad pushed her away, he still loved her.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The moment the triangle re-forms and Belly understands Conrad never stopped wanting her.

beats.label: S2 · Laurel saves the house
beats.text: Laurel arrives, reaches Julia over the sister she lost and convinces her to back out. Adam agrees to sell the Boston house instead, keeping the Fishers' summer home.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Resolves the season's plot engine and locks Cousins in as the setting for what follows.

beats.label: S2 · Motel storm
beats.text: Stranded in a motel storm, Conrad tells Belly he still wants her — then retracts it in the morning to protect Jeremiah. He leaves and breaks down alone.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The buried truth that Conrad carries into the entire S3 time jump.

beats.label: S2 · Choosing Jeremiah
beats.text: Belly and Jeremiah drive back to Philadelphia as a couple; Steven and Taylor also finally choose each other. Conrad returns to Cousins to clean the house alone.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The final positions the S3 time jump opens from.

cliffhanger.text: Susannah is gone, but the beach house is saved. Belly is with Jeremiah; Conrad has retreated to Cousins alone after burying his feelings for her a second time.
questions: Can Belly and Jeremiah last while Conrad still loves her in silence?
What does Conrad do with a truth he refused to say out loud?
Can these two families keep gathering at Cousins without Susannah at the center of it?

characters.name: Belly Conklin
characters.line: Newly with Jeremiah, unaware Conrad still wants her; still grieving Susannah.

characters.name: Jeremiah Fisher
characters.line: Together with Belly and headed to Finch College; asked Conrad point-blank to step aside and believes he did.

characters.name: Conrad Fisher
characters.line: Transferring to Stanford; buried his feelings for Belly a second time to protect Jeremiah, alone at Cousins.

characters.name: Susannah Fisher
characters.line: Died between seasons of the cancer revealed at the S1 ball; the reason both families keep fighting for the beach house.

characters.name: Adam Fisher
characters.line: The Fisher boys' father; agreed to sell the Boston family home so Cousins could stay in the family.

characters.name: Laurel Park
characters.line: Wrote a book about Susannah; broke through Julia's grief to save the house.

characters.name: Steven Conklin
characters.line: Belly's brother and valedictorian; finally got together with Taylor at the end of the summer.

characters.name: Taylor Jewel
characters.line: Belly's best friend, now with Steven.

beats.label: S3 · Cabo
beats.text: Years on, Belly and Taylor are at Finch with Jeremiah; Conrad is in California. Belly overhears that Jeremiah slept with a sorority girl in Cabo and confronts him.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The time jump plus the first crack in Belly and Jeremiah's relationship.

beats.label: S3 · Christmas and a ring
beats.text: A flashback reveals Belly and Conrad secretly met at Cousins last Christmas — a moment Jeremiah doesn't know about. Belly forgives Jeremiah's affair and accepts his proposal.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Plants the hidden Conrad encounter that becomes the wedding-day detonator.

beats.label: S3 · Memorial garden
beats.text: The families gather in Cousins to dedicate Susannah's memorial garden. Belly and Jeremiah announce their engagement there, and neither family takes it well.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Turns the private engagement into a public one and puts every family member's ambivalence on the table.

beats.label: S3 · Adam's wedding
beats.text: Adam offers to fund a lavish country-club wedding. Conrad, bound by a deathbed promise to protect Jeremiah, delays his departure and stays as best man.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Explains why Conrad is in every scene of the run-up, and why the wedding scale keeps escalating past Belly's comfort.

beats.label: S3 · Bachelor party confession
beats.text: Conrad ends up helping Belly plan while Jere works late. She nearly kisses him one afternoon; at the bachelor party he tells her he still loves her, and she pushes him away.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The confession Belly has to lie about carrying into the wedding.

beats.label: S3 · The swapped letter
beats.text: A letter Susannah wrote for Conrad is accidentally given to Belly instead. Confronted by Jeremiah, Belly admits she still loves Conrad, and the wedding is called off.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The single event that ends the marriage and reroutes all three leads.

beats.label: S3 · Paris train platform
beats.text: Belly flees to Paris alone. Conrad writes her letters for months; when she answers, he flies out for her birthday, and she chases his departing train and chooses him.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The show's final choice — the answer to the S1 triangle six years in the making.

cliffhanger.text: The wedding fell apart on the day. Belly and Conrad chose each other in Paris; Jeremiah, cut off by Adam, is starting again in a kitchen, and Steven and Taylor are heading to San Francisco.
questions: Can Belly and Conrad's Paris beginning survive coming back to Cousins?
Does Jeremiah stay reconciled with the brother who ended up with his fiancée?
What does a Cousins summer look like now that the next generation has scattered?

characters.name: Belly Conklin
characters.line: Called off her wedding to Jeremiah after admitting she still loves Conrad; ran to Paris and finally chose Conrad there.

characters.name: Conrad Fisher
characters.line: Confessed to Belly the week of her wedding; flew to Paris and reunited with her on a departing train.

characters.name: Jeremiah Fisher
characters.line: Jilted at the altar after his own Cabo affair; cut off by Adam, rebuilding in a culinary career.

characters.name: Adam Fisher
characters.line: The Fisher boys' father; funded then lost the wedding and cut Jeremiah off financially over it.

characters.name: Steven Conklin
characters.line: Belly's brother; survived a car accident, quit his job to build a startup, and is heading to San Francisco with Taylor.

characters.name: Taylor Jewel
characters.line: Back with Steven; delivered hard truths to both Belly and Conrad on wedding day.

characters.name: Laurel Park
characters.line: Belly's mother; initially refused to help with the wedding, then came around before it fell apart.
